newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Erste super board approves merger with Girocredit.
newsitem.headline: Erste super board approves merger with Girocredit.

text.p: Austrian savings bank Die Erste said on Wednesday its supervisory board had agreed to integrate Girocredit Bank AG into the group.
In a statement released ahead of a news conference, Die Erste said the fusion would go ahead as quickly as possible, but definitely before September 30.
First Austrian acquired a majority stake in Girocredit for 8.24 billion schillings ($676.3 million) in March.
The acquisition of the stake from Vienna City holding AVZ raised Die Erste's stake in Girocredit to 82 percent of ordinary voting shares.
Together, the two savings banks form the country's second biggest banking group with combined assets of almost 670 billion schillings and a total of 360 branches across Austria.

The deal came hot on the heels of the market leader Bank Austria's acquisition in January of rival Creditanstalt, which at the time was expected to lead to a wave of mergers in the nation's overcrowded banking sector.
